domains.note: §11c: Composio's MCP server → 1000+ apps as namespaced composio__* tools. STUB — set COMPOSIO_API_KEY in .env and confirm the launch command matches your Composio CLI version; an unconfigured/missing binary is skipped at startup, never crashes serve. No `actions` map on purpose: each tool falls to the F0 gate's name heuristic (classifyTool), so composio__GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL classifies as send (always asks) while composio__*_FETCH_* classifies as read (auto). A blanket '*' override would wrongly declassify the send/delete tools.
